sql: SELECT n.ne_name, n.ne_state, c.customer_name, n.state_update_time FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id WHERE n.ne_state NOT IN ('active', 'unknown') ORDER BY n.state_update_time DESC

question: 统计最近30天内，每个客户产生的Major级别以上的告警数量，并按数量降序排列。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.id) AS major_critical_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id WHERE eh.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major') AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name ORDER BY major_critical_count DESC

question: 查询设备SZ-Switch-05的历史告警记录，按告警类型统计次数，并只显示次数大于5的告警类型。
sql: SELECT eh.event_type, COUNT(eh.id) AS count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.id WHERE n.ne_name = 'SZ-Switch-05' GROUP BY eh.event_type HAVING count > 5 ORDER BY count DESC

question: 列出平台上所有客户及其主要联系人的姓名和电话，同时统计该客户下在线的设备数量。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ct.contact_name, ct.phone, COUNT(CASE WHEN n.ne_state = 'active' THEN 1 END) AS online_devices FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_contact ct ON c.id = ct.customer_id AND ct.is_primary = 1 LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.id = n.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name, ct.contact_name, ct.phone

question: 统计上周工作日早上9点到下午6点之间，全平台产生的告警总数，并按小时维度展示分布。
sql: SELECT HOUR(eh.start_time) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(eh.id) AS alarm_count FROM event_history eh WHERE YEARWEEK(eh.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1) AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND HOUR(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 9 AND 17 GROUP BY HOUR(eh.start_time) ORDER BY hour_of_day

question: 查询客户JKL制造在华东区域的所有设备，列出设备名称、IP、设备类型以及其绑定的服务包名称。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, n.ip_address, nt.type_name, nsp.service_package_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.id JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.id LEFT JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON n.id = nsp.ne_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'JKL制造' AND r.region_name LIKE '%华东%'

question: 找出最近3个月内从未产生过任何告警的设备，列出其设备名称、所属客户和设备类型。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, c.customer_name, nt.type_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.id WHERE n.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ne_id FROM event_history WHERE start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH))

question: 统计每个采集机当前负责监控的设备数量，以及这些设备中处于down状态的数量。
sql: SELECT cv.collector_name, COUNT(n.id) AS total_devices, COUNT(CASE WHEN n.ne_state = 'down' THEN 1 END) AS down_devices FROM collector_v2 cv LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON cv.id = n.collector_id GROUP BY cv.id, cv.collector_name ORDER BY total_devices DESC

question: 查询某设备HK-Firewall-02上个月的所有告警详情，包括告警时间、告警类型、告警级别和告警描述。
sql: SELECT eh.start_time, eh.event_type, eh.severity, eh.description FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.id WHERE n.ne_name = 'HK-Firewall-02' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY eh.start_time DESC

question: 列出所有客户，并显示他们最近一次产生告警的时间。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, MAX(eh.start_time) AS last_alarm_time FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.id = n.customer_id LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON n.id = eh.ne_id GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name ORDER BY last_alarm_time DESC

question: 统计最近一周内，不同设备类型产生的Critical级别告警的数量。
sql: SELECT nt.type_name, COUNT(eh.id) AS critical_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.id JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.id WHERE eh.severity = 'Critical' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) GROUP BY nt.id, nt.type_name ORDER BY critical_count DESC

question: 查询客户MNO证券名下，设备状态的分布情况，即每种状态各有多少台设备。
sql: SELECT n.ne_state, COUNT(n.id) AS state_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.customer_name = 'MNO证券' GROUP BY n.ne_state ORDER BY state_count DESC

question: 找出告警历史中，那些告警已经恢复但恢复耗时超过4小时的事件，列出设备名、客户名和告警持续时间。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, c.customer_name, eh.start_time, eh.end_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, eh.end_time) AS duration_hours FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id WHERE eh.end_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, eh.end_time) > 4 ORDER BY duration_hours DESC

question: 客户ABC公司最近一个月内，有哪些设备产生了告警？请列出设备名称、IP地址和告警总数。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, n.ip_address, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id
WHERE c.customer_name = 'ABC公司'
  AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY n.ne_id, n.ne_name, n.ip_address
HAVING alarm_count > 0
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC;

question: 统计上个月每个设备类型产生的告警数量，并按告警数量降序排列。
sql:
SELECT nt.type_name AS device_type, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count
FROM ne_type nt
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON nt.type_id = n.ne_type_id
JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id
WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND eh.event_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
GROUP BY nt.type_id, nt.type_name
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC;

question: 查询华东区域所有状态为Down的设备，并关联显示其所属客户名称和联系人电话。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, n.ip_address, c.customer_name, ct.phone AS contact_phone
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_contact ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id AND ct.is_primary = 1
WHERE r.region_name = '华东'
  AND n.ne_state = 'Down';

question: 列出近一周告警级别为严重且尚未恢复的告警详情，包括设备名、客户名和告警发生时间。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, c.customer_name, eh.event_time, eh.event_summary
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE eh.event_level = '严重'
  AND eh.recovery_time IS NULL
  AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY eh.event_time DESC;

question: 统计每个客户下，设备状态为Active和Down的数量分别是多少。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.ne_state = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.ne_state = 'Down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_count
FROM t_bz_config_customer c
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.customer_id = n.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY c.customer_name;

question: 查询设备BJ-Router-01最近一年内，每个月产生的告警数量趋势。
sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(event_time, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       COUNT(event_id) AS alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
WHERE n.ne_name = 'BJ-Router-01'
  AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(event_time, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;

question: 找出平台上告警持续时间最长的前10条记录，显示设备名、客户名和持续时间。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, c.customer_name,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.event_time, eh.recovery_time) AS duration_hours,
       eh.event_summary
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE eh.recovery_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY duration_hours DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: 统计上周每天产生的不同级别告警的数量。
sql:
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS day,
       event_level,
       COUNT(event_id) AS alarm_count
FROM event_history
WHERE YEARWEEK(event_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1)
GROUP BY DATE(event_time), event_level
ORDER BY day, FIELD(event_level, '严重', '重要', '警告');

question: 查询客户XYZ科技下，所有绑定了金牌服务套餐的设备清单及其IP地址。
sql:

JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON n.ne_id = nsp.ne_id
WHERE c.customer_name = 'XYZ科技'
  AND nsp.service_package_name = '金牌服务';

question: 列出最近3个月内没有任何告警产生的设备，并显示其所属客户和最后上线时间。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, c.customer_name, n.last_online_time
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
WHERE eh.event_id IS NULL
  AND n.ne_state = 'Active';

question: 统计每个区域内，设备状态为Down的数量，并关联显示负责该区域的采集机名称。
sql:
SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(n.ne_id) AS down_device_count, cv2.collector_name
FROM t_bz_config_region r
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON r.region_id = n.region_id AND n.ne_state = 'Down'
LEFT JOIN collector_v2 cv2 ON r.collector_id = cv2.collector_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name, cv2.collector_name
ORDER BY down_device_count DESC;

question: 查询某客户DEF集团在最近一个季度内，各级别告警的占比情况。
sql:
SELECT eh.event_level,
       COUNT(eh.event_id) AS count,
       ROUND(COUNT(eh.event_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(eh.event_id)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_name = 'DEF集团'
  AND eh.event_time >= '2024-04-01'
  AND eh.event_time < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY eh.event_level
ORDER BY FIELD(eh.event_level, '严重', '重要', '警告');

question: 找出近一个月内告警次数最多的前5台设备，并显示其所属客户和告警次数。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id
WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY n.ne_id, n.ne_name, c.customer_name
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 查询设备SH-Switch-05的所有历史告警，并按告警类型进行分类统计。
sql:
SELECT eh.event_type, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
WHERE n.ne_name = 'SH-Switch-05'
GROUP BY eh.event_type
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC;

question: 统计平台上所有路由器类型的设备，按照其软件版本进行分组，并统计每个版本的设备数量。
sql:
SELECT n.software_version, COUNT(n.ne_id) AS device_count
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.type_id
WHERE nt.type_name LIKE '%路由器%'
GROUP BY n.software_version
HAVING n.software_version IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY device_count DESC;

question: 列出客户GHI银行下，所有IP地址以10.20.开头的设备，并显示其当前状态和最后采集时间。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, n.ip_address, n.ne_state, n.last_collect_time
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_name = 'GHI银行'
  AND n.ip_address LIKE '10.20.%';

question: 查询最近一周内，由采集机Collector-Beijing-01负责采集的设备所产生的告警总数。
sql:
SELECT COUNT(eh.event_id) AS total_alarms
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
JOIN collector_v2 cv2 ON n.collector_id = cv2.collector_id
WHERE cv2.collector_name = 'Collector-Beijing-01'
  AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

question: 统计每个设备类型的平均告警响应时间，只统计已确认的告警。
sql:
SELECT nt.type_name AS device_type,
       AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.event_time, eh.ack_time)) AS avg_response_minutes
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.type_id
WHERE eh.ack_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY nt.type_id, nt.type_name
HAVING avg_response_minutes IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY avg_response_minutes DESC;

question: 找出上个月工作日上午9点到下午6点之间，产生过告警的所有设备及其客户。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT n.ne_name AS device_name, c.customer_name
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND eh.event_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.event_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6
  AND TIME(eh.event_time) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '18:00:00';

question: 查询状态为Down超过48小时的设备，并关联其服务包信息，看是否在服务期内。
sql:
SELECT n.ne_name AS device_name, n.ip_address, c.customer_name,
       nsp.service_package_name, nsp.start_time, nsp.end_time
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON n.ne_id = nsp.ne_id
WHERE n.ne_state = 'Down'
  AND n.last_online_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR);

question: 统计最近30天内，每个客户产生的性能类告警的数量排名。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS performance_alarm_count
FROM t_bz_config_customer c
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.customer_id = n.customer_id
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND eh.event_type LIKE '%performance%'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY performance_alarm_count DESC
LIMIT 15;

question: 列出所有采集机状态不是健康的采集机，并显示其负责的区域和关联的客户数量。
sql:
SELECT cv2.collector_name, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM collector_v2 cv2
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON cv2.collector_id = r.collector_id
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.region_id = c.region_id
WHERE cv2.health_status != '健康'
GROUP BY cv2.collector_id, cv2.collector_name, r.region_name;

question: 查询设备GZ-Firewall-02最近一年的告警历史，并标记出哪些告警是在其绑定的高级防护服务包生效期间发生的。
sql:
SELECT eh.event_time, eh.event_level, eh.event_summary,
       CASE WHEN eh.event_time BETWEEN nsp.start_time AND nsp.end_time THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS during_service
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id
LEFT JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON n.ne_id = nsp.ne_id AND nsp.service_package_name = '高级防护'
WHERE n.ne_name = 'GZ-Firewall-02'
  AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
ORDER BY eh.event_time DESC;

question: 统计平台上不同厂商的设备数量分布。
sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN n.ne_name LIKE '%Cisco%' OR n.model LIKE '%Cisco%' THEN 'Cisco'
    WHEN n.ne_name LIKE '%Huawei%' OR n.model LIKE '%Huawei%' THEN 'Huawei'
    WHEN n.ne_name LIKE '%H3C%' OR n.model LIKE '%H3C%' THEN 'H3C'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS vendor,
  COUNT(n.ne_id) AS device_count
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
GROUP BY vendor
ORDER BY device_count DESC;

question: 找出最近3天内产生过告警，且其所属客户的主要联系人电话为空的设备清单。

question: 客户ABC公司最近一个月内，哪些设备产生的告警次数最多？请给出设备名称和告警次数的排名。

question: 统计上个月全平台所有设备，按设备类型分组，看看每种类型的设备各有多少台处于激活状态。

question: 列出平台上所有客户，以及他们名下分别有多少台设备，按设备数量从多到少排序。

question: 设备Router-Core-01在过去一年里，每个月各发生了多少次告警？按月统计出来。
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(eh.event_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE n.ne_name = 'Router-Core-01' AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(eh.event_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

question: 查询一下，哪些设备关联的服务包是白金套餐，并且设备状态是active的？列出设备名和客户名。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, c.customer_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN ne_service_package sp ON n.ne_id = sp.ne_id WHERE sp.package_name = '白金套餐' AND n.activation_state = 'active'

question: 统计最近一个月，每个采集机负责监控的设备数量，并列出采集机名称和设备数量。
sql: SELECT cv.collector_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ne_id) AS monitored_device_count FROM collector_v2 cv JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON cv.collector_id = n.collector_id WHERE n.update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY cv.collector_id, cv.collector_name

question: 客户DEF集团的设备，按照不同的区域分组，统计每个区域有多少台设备，并列出设备详情。
sql: SELECT r.region_name, n.ne_name, n.ip_address, n.device_state FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'DEF集团' ORDER BY r.region_name, n.ne_name

question: 找出上周所有级别为严重的告警，并且这些告警还没有被确认，列出告警ID、设备名和发生时间。
sql: SELECT eh.event_id, n.ne_name, eh.event_time FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE eh.severity = '严重' AND eh.acknowledged = 0 AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

question: 查询设备Switch-Access-05的历史告警，按告警类型进行分类统计。
sql: SELECT eh.event_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE n.ne_name = 'Switch-Access-05' GROUP BY eh.event_type ORDER BY count DESC

question: 列出所有客户及其主要联系人的姓名和电话，需要关联客户表和联系人表。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ct.contact_name, ct.phone FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_contact ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.is_primary = 1

question: 最近三个月，平台上新增了多少台设备？按设备类型统计新增数量。
sql: SELECT nt.type_name, COUNT(*) AS new_device_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.type_id WHERE n.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY nt.type_id, nt.type_name

question: 找出告警持续时间最长的TOP 10条记录，需要显示告警ID、设备名、告警开始时间和持续时间。
sql: SELECT eh.event_id, n.ne_name, eh.event_time AS start_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.event_time, COALESCE(eh.recovery_time, NOW())) AS duration_minutes FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE eh.recovery_time IS NOT NULL OR eh.event_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY duration_minutes DESC LIMIT 10

question: 统计某客户GHI银行在工作日上午9点到下午6点之间产生的告警总数。
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS work_hour_alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'GHI银行' AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.event_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND TIME(eh.event_time) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '18:00:00'

question: 查询所有状态为active，但是所属采集机状态为offline的设备，列出设备名和采集机名。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, cv.collector_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN collector_v2 cv ON n.collector_id = cv.collector_id WHERE n.activation_state = 'active' AND cv.health_state = 'offline'

question: 按区域统计，最近一周内，每个区域产生的重要级别以上的告警数量。
sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS high_severity_alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id WHERE eh.severity IN ('严重', '重要') AND eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name

question: 列出客户JKL教育名下所有设备的不同状态的数量统计。
sql: SELECT n.device_state, COUNT(*) AS state_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'JKL教育' GROUP BY n.device_state

question: 查找近一个月告警次数超过10次的所有设备，并给出具体告警次数。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY n.ne_id, n.ne_name HAVING alarm_count > 10 ORDER BY alarm_count DESC

question: 查询某个设备Firewall-Edge-02的详细配置信息，以及它所属的客户和区域信息。
sql: SELECT n.*, c.customer_name, r.region_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id WHERE n.ne_name = 'Firewall-Edge-02'

question: 统计上周每天产生的告警总数，按日期排序。
sql: SELECT DATE(eh.event_time) AS alarm_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_alarm_count FROM event_history eh WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(eh.event_time) ORDER BY alarm_date

question: 找出那些设备状态为down，但是最近24小时内没有产生任何新告警的设备，可能是静默故障。
sql: SELECT n.ne_name, n.ip_address, n.state_change_time FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n WHERE n.device_state = 'down' AND n.ne_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT eh.ne_id FROM event_history eh WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) )

question: 查询客户MNO医疗的告警处理情况，列出超过48小时还未被确认的告警清单。
sql: SELECT eh.event_id, n.ne_name, eh.event_time, eh.event_type FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'MNO医疗' AND eh.acknowledged = 0 AND eh.event_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)

question: 按设备类型统计，看看哪种类型的设备平均告警数量最高。
sql: SELECT nt.type_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.ne_id) AS avg_alarm_per_device FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.type_id WHERE eh.event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY nt.type_id, nt.type_name ORDER BY avg_alarm_per_device DESC

question: 列出所有采集机及其负责的客户数量，按客户数量排序。
sql: SELECT cv.collector_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM collector_v2 cv JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON cv.collector_id = n.collector_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY cv.collector_id, cv.collector_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: 客户ABC公司最近一个月内，有哪些设备产生了告警？请列出设备名称、IP地址和告警总次数。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, n.ip_address, COUNT(eh.event_id) as alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'ABC公司' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY n.device_name, n.ip_address HAVING alarm_count > 0 ORDER BY alarm_count DESC;

question: 统计上个月全平台告警级别为严重和紧急的告警数量，并按设备类型进行分组。
sql: SELECT nt.type_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as severe_alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id WHERE eh.severity IN ('严重', '紧急') AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY nt.type_name ORDER BY severe_alarm_count DESC;

question: 列出所有状态为down超过7天但还未恢复的设备，并关联其所属客户名称和区域信息。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, n.ip_address, c.customer_name, r.region_name, n.state, n.last_state_change FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id WHERE n.state = 'down' AND n.last_state_change <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

question: 查询客户XYZ科技名下，每个设备类型各有多少台设备，并列出设备类型名称和数量。
sql: SELECT nt.type_name, COUNT(n.ne_id) as device_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'XYZ科技' GROUP BY nt.type_name ORDER BY device_count DESC;

question: 近一周内，哪些采集机负责的设备产生的告警总数最多？给出采集机名称和告警数量的TOP 5排名。
sql: SELECT cv2.collector_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as alarm_count FROM collector_v2 cv2 JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON cv2.collector_id = n.collector_id JOIN event_history eh ON n.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY cv2.collector_name ORDER BY alarm_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计最近一年每个季度，客户DEF集团产生的各级别告警的数量。
sql: SELECT QUARTER(eh.start_time) as quarter, eh.severity, COUNT(eh.event_id) as alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'DEF集团' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY QUARTER(eh.start_time), eh.severity ORDER BY quarter, FIELD(eh.severity, '紧急', '严重', '主要', '次要', '警告');

question: 查询设备router-core-01在过去三个月内，绑定过哪些服务包？列出服务包名称和绑定时间。
sql: SELECT nsp.package_name, nsp.create_time FROM ne_service_package nsp JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON nsp.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE n.device_name = 'router-core-01' AND nsp.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) ORDER BY nsp.create_time DESC;

question: 找出最近一个月内，告警平均持续时间最长的TOP 10设备，并显示设备名和客户名。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, c.customer_name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, eh.start_time, eh.end_time)) as avg_duration_seconds FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND eh.end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.device_name, c.customer_name ORDER BY avg_duration_seconds DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计华北区域所有客户在上一周的工作日产生的告警总数。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as weekday_alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_code = 'north_china' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(NOW())) + 7 DAY) AND eh.start_time < DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(NOW())) DAY) AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY weekday_alarm_count DESC;

question: 列出平台上所有防火墙类型的设备，并显示其当前状态、管理IP和所属客户的服务级别联系人姓名。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, n.ip_address, n.state, c.customer_name, ct.contact_name, ct.phone FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_contact ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id AND ct.is_primary = 1 WHERE nt.type_name LIKE '%防火墙%';

question: 查询客户GHI银行名下，哪些设备在最近一周内没有产生任何告警？列出这些安静的设备名称和IP。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, n.ip_address FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'GHI银行' AND n.ne_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT eh.ne_id FROM event_history eh WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) );

question: 统计每个区域内，设备状态为active的设备数量，并列出区域名称和活跃设备数，按数量降序排列。
sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(n.ne_id) as active_device_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id WHERE n.state = 'active' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY active_device_count DESC;

question: 找出上个月告警次数环比增长最多的前3个客户。显示客户名、上个月告警数、上上个月告警数和增长量。
sql: WITH current_month AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as current_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ), last_month AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(eh.event_id) as last_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND eh.start_time < DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY c.customer_id ) SELECT cm.customer_name, cm.current_count, COALESCE(lm.last_count, 0) as last_count, (cm.current_count - COALESCE(lm.last_count, 0)) as increase FROM current_month cm LEFT JOIN last_month lm ON cm.customer_id = lm.customer_id ORDER BY increase DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 查询设备switch-access-05的历史告警，按告警类型统计最近90天内的发生次数，并列出类型名称。
sql: SELECT et.type_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as count FROM event_history eh JOIN event_type et ON eh.event_type_id = et.event_type_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE n.device_name = 'switch-access-05' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY et.type_name ORDER BY count DESC;

question: 列出所有采集机状态不是active的采集机，以及它们所负责的、当前状态为down的设备清单。
sql: SELECT cv2.collector_name, cv2.status as collector_status, n.device_name, n.ip_address, n.state as device_state FROM collector_v2 cv2 JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON cv2.collector_id = n.collector_id WHERE cv2.status != 'active' AND n.state = 'down';

question: 统计最近半年内，每个客户产生的网络连通性相关告警的数量，并列出客户名和告警数。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as connectivity_alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN event_type et ON eh.event_type_id = et.event_type_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE (et.type_name LIKE '%连通性%' OR et.type_name LIKE '%ping%') AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY connectivity_alarm_count DESC;

question: 查询某客户JKL制造的设备，按照不同场所分别统计设备数量，并列出场所名和设备清单。
sql: SELECT n.location, COUNT(n.ne_id) as device_count, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(n.device_name, ' (', n.ip_address, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') as device_list FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'JKL制造' GROUP BY n.location ORDER BY device_count DESC;

question: 找出最近一周内，同时被多个客户设备告警所引用的、出现频率最高的前5个告警根因描述。
sql: SELECT eh.root_cause, COUNT(DISTINCT n.customer_id) as affected_customer_count, COUNT(eh.event_id) as alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND eh.root_cause IS NOT NULL AND eh.root_cause != '' GROUP BY eh.root_cause HAVING affected_customer_count > 1 ORDER BY alarm_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计每个设备类型下，状态为active的设备所占的百分比。列出设备类型名称、总设备数、活跃设备数和活跃率。
sql: SELECT nt.type_name, COUNT(n.ne_id) as total_devices, SUM(CASE WHEN n.state = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_devices, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.state = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(n.ne_id), 2) as active_rate FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id GROUP BY nt.type_name HAVING total_devices > 0 ORDER BY active_rate DESC;

question: 查询客户MNO零售在过去24小时内新产生的、且尚未被确认的告警详情，包括设备名、告警级别、告警标题和产生时间。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, eh.severity, eh.event_title, eh.start_time FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'MNO零售' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND eh.ack_time IS NULL ORDER BY eh.start_time DESC;

question: 列出所有核心路由器设备，并显示其最近一次绑定的服务包名称，以及该服务包下的服务项数量。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, nsp.package_name, COUNT(nsi.item_id) as service_item_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN ne_type nt ON n.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ne_id, package_name, create_time FROM ne_service_package WHERE (ne_id, create_time) IN (SELECT ne_id, MAX(create_time) FROM ne_service_package GROUP BY ne_id)) nsp ON n.ne_id = nsp.ne_id LEFT JOIN ne_service_item nsi ON nsp.package_id = nsi.package_id WHERE nt.type_name LIKE '%核心路由器%' GROUP BY n.device_name, nsp.package_name ORDER BY n.device_name;

question: 统计上周每天产生的告警总数，并按天和告警级别绘制数据所需的统计结果。
sql: SELECT DATE(eh.start_time) as alarm_date, eh.severity, COUNT(eh.event_id) as daily_count FROM event_history eh WHERE YEARWEEK(eh.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1) AND eh.severity IN ('严重', '主要', '次要') GROUP BY DATE(eh.start_time), eh.severity ORDER BY alarm_date, FIELD(eh.severity, '严重', '主要', '次要');

question: 找出客户PQR物流名下，哪些设备的CPU利用率相关监控项在最近一个月内曾触发过告警？列出设备名和触发次数。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) as cpu_alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'PQR物流' AND eh.event_title LIKE '%CPU%' AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY n.device_name HAVING cpu_alarm_count > 0 ORDER BY cpu_alarm_count DESC;

question: 查询平台中，设备型号为Cisco-ASR1002的所有设备，并关联其所属客户、区域以及当前负责的采集机信息。
sql: SELECT n.device_name, n.model, c.customer_name, r.region_name, cv2.collector_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON n.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN collector_v2 cv2 ON n.collector_id = cv2.collector_id WHERE n.model = 'Cisco-ASR1002';

question: 统计最近一个完整月份，每个客户告警的首次响应平均时间，只统计已确认的告警。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.ack_time)) as avg_first_response_minutes FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON eh.ne_id = n.ne_id JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE eh.ack_time IS NOT NULL AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY c.customer_name HAVING avg_first_response_minutes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_first_response_minutes;

question: 帮我查一下，客户ABC公司在最近一年内，工作日上班时间发生的所有告警，按告警级别和告警类型分别统计一下数量。
sql:
SELECT 
    eh.severity AS 告警级别,
    eh.event_type AS 告警类型,
    COUNT(*) AS 告警数量
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE cust.customer_name = 'ABC公司'
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
  AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 -- 周一(2) 到 周五(6)
  AND TIME(eh.start_time) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '18:00:00'
GROUP BY eh.severity, eh.event_type
ORDER BY eh.severity, 告警数量 DESC;

question: 找出全平台范围内，当前状态为Down且持续时间超过3个月的所有设备，并列出它们的设备名称、IP地址、所属客户名称、以及状态变为Down的具体时间。
sql:
SELECT 
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名称,
    ne.ip_address AS IP地址,
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名称,
    ne.state_change_time AS 状态变更时间
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE ne.state = 'Down'
  AND ne.state_change_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH);

question: 统计一下，每个客户在最近一个月内，告警次数最多的前3台设备分别是哪些？需要显示客户名、设备名和告警次数。
sql:
WITH RankedAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        cust.customer_name,
        ne.ne_name,
        COUNT(eh.id) AS alert_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust.id ORDER BY COUNT(eh.id) DESC) AS rn
    FROM event_history eh
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
    GROUP BY cust.id, cust.customer_name, ne.id, ne.ne_name
)
SELECT customer_name AS 客户名, ne_name AS 设备名, alert_count AS 告警次数
FROM RankedAlerts
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY customer_name, alert_count DESC;

question: 查询华东区域的所有客户，他们各自拥有的设备中，处于Active状态的设备数量与总设备数量的比例是多少？按比例从低到高排序。
sql:
SELECT 
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ne.state = 'Active' THEN 1 END) AS 活跃设备数,
    COUNT(ne.id) AS 总设备数,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN ne.state = 'Active' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ne.id), 2) AS 活跃比例
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_region reg ON cust.region_id = reg.id
WHERE reg.region_name = '华东'
GROUP BY cust.id, cust.customer_name
ORDER BY 活跃比例 ASC;

question: 找出那些告警从产生到现在，持续时间超过24小时且仍未恢复的告警，列出告警标题、设备名、客户名、告警级别和持续时间。
sql:
SELECT 
    eh.title AS 告警标题,
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名,
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名,
    eh.severity AS 告警级别,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, NOW()) AS 持续时间_小时
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE eh.end_time IS NULL
  AND eh.start_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
ORDER BY 持续时间_小时 DESC;

question: 统计每个设备类型下，关联了金牌服务包的设备数量，以及这些设备中当前状态为Down的比例。
sql:
SELECT 
    nt.type_name AS 设备类型,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id) AS 关联金牌服务包设备数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ne.state = 'Down' THEN ne.id END) AS 其中Down的设备数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ne.state = 'Down' THEN ne.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id), 2) AS Down比例
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
INNER JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
INNER JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id
WHERE nsp.service_package_name = '金牌服务包'
GROUP BY nt.id, nt.type_name
ORDER BY 关联金牌服务包设备数 DESC;

question: 查询上周全平台产生的告警，按小时统计告警数量，找出告警最集中的三个小时段。
sql:
WITH HourlyAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        HOUR(start_time) AS 小时,
        COUNT(*) AS 告警数量
    FROM event_history
    WHERE YEARWEEK(start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1)
    GROUP BY HOUR(start_time)
)
SELECT 小时, 告警数量
FROM HourlyAlerts
ORDER BY 告警数量 DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: 找出那些在最近30天内没有任何告警产生的客户，列出他们的客户名称、联系人姓名和电话。
sql:
SELECT 
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名称,
    cont.contact_name AS 联系人姓名,
    cont.phone AS 电话
FROM t_bz_config_customer cust
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_contact cont ON cust.id = cont.customer_id AND cont.is_primary = 1
WHERE cust.id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ne.customer_id
    FROM event_history eh
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
)
ORDER BY cust.customer_name;

question: 对于设备cisco-core-01，查询它过去一年每个月的平均告警持续时间，只统计已恢复的告警。
sql:
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m') AS 年月,
    ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time)), 2) AS 平均告警时长_分钟
FROM event_history
WHERE ne_id = (SELECT id FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root WHERE ne_name = 'cisco-core-01')
  AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
  AND end_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY 年月 DESC;

question: 列出所有采集机及其负责采集的设备数量，同时显示这些设备中，上周产生过Critical级别告警的设备数量。
sql:
SELECT 
    cv2.name AS 采集机名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id) AS 负责设备总数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eh.severity = 'Critical' AND YEARWEEK(eh.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1) THEN ne.id END) AS 上周有Critical告警的设备数
FROM collector_v2 cv2
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv2.id = ne.collector_id
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id
GROUP BY cv2.id, cv2.name
ORDER BY 负责设备总数 DESC;

question: 查询某客户XYZ科技下，不同设备状态的设备清单，并统计每个状态下设备的最近一次告警时间。
sql:
SELECT 
    ne.state AS 设备状态,
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名称,
    ne.ip_address AS IP地址,
    MAX(eh.start_time) AS 最近告警时间
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE cust.customer_name = 'XYZ科技'

question: 统计每个区域在最近一个季度内，产生的Major及以上级别告警的总数，并计算这些告警的平均恢复时间。
sql:
SELECT 
    reg.region_name AS 区域名称,
    COUNT(eh.id) AS Major以上告警总数,
    ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, eh.end_time)), 2) AS 平均恢复时间_小时
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_region reg ON cust.region_id = reg.id
WHERE eh.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major')
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  AND eh.end_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY reg.id, reg.region_name
ORDER BY Major以上告警总数 DESC;

question: 找出那些在最近一周内，告警次数环比上一周增长超过50%的设备，列出设备名、所属客户、本周告警次数和上周告警次数。
sql:
WITH CurrentWeek AS (
    SELECT 
        ne.id,
        ne.ne_name,
        cust.customer_name,
        COUNT(eh.id) AS current_count
    FROM event_history eh
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
    WHERE YEARWEEK(eh.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1)
    GROUP BY ne.id, ne.ne_name, cust.customer_name
),
LastWeek AS (
    SELECT 
        ne.id,
        COUNT(eh.id) AS last_count
    FROM event_history eh
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    WHERE YEARWEEK(eh.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1)
    GROUP BY ne.id
)
SELECT 
    cw.ne_name AS 设备名,
    cw.customer_name AS 客户名,
    cw.current_count AS 本周告警数,
    COALESCE(lw.last_count, 0) AS 上周告警数,
    ROUND((cw.current_count - COALESCE(lw.last_count, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(lw.last_count, 0), 0), 2) AS 增长率
FROM CurrentWeek cw
LEFT JOIN LastWeek lw ON cw.id = lw.id
WHERE COALESCE(lw.last_count, 0) > 0
  AND (cw.current_count - COALESCE(lw.last_count, 0)) * 1.0 / COALESCE(lw.last_count, 0) > 0.5
ORDER BY 增长率 DESC;

question: 查询所有客户，列出他们设备总数、已绑定白金服务包的设备数，以及这些白金设备中状态为Active的比例。
sql:
SELECT 
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id) AS 设备总数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nsp.service_package_name = '白金服务包' THEN ne.id END) AS 白金设备数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nsp.service_package_name = '白金服务包' AND ne.state = 'Active' THEN ne.id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nsp.service_package_name = '白金服务包' THEN ne.id END), 0), 2) AS 白金设备活跃率
FROM t_bz_config_customer cust
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cust.id = ne.customer_id
LEFT JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id
GROUP BY cust.id, cust.customer_name
HAVING 白金设备数 > 0
ORDER BY 白金设备数 DESC;

question: 找出过去24小时内，产生告警次数最多的前5台设备，并列出这些告警的级别分布。
sql:
WITH TopDevices AS (
    SELECT 
        ne.id,
        ne.ne_name,
        COUNT(eh.id) AS total_alerts
    FROM event_history eh
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
    GROUP BY ne.id, ne.ne_name
    ORDER BY total_alerts DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    td.ne_name AS 设备名,
    td.total_alerts AS 总告警数,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN eh.severity = 'Critical' THEN 1 END) AS Critical,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN eh.severity = 'Major' THEN 1 END) AS Major,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN eh.severity = 'Minor' THEN 1 END) AS Minor,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN eh.severity = 'Warning' THEN 1 END) AS Warning
FROM TopDevices td
INNER JOIN event_history eh ON td.id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
GROUP BY td.id, td.ne_name, td.total_alerts
ORDER BY td.total_alerts DESC;

question: 统计每个设备类型下，设备的平均在线率，并列出在线率最低的3种设备类型。
sql:
SELECT 
    nt.type_name AS 设备类型,
    ROUND(AVG(oa.availability), 2) AS 平均在线率
FROM origin_availability oa
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON oa.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
WHERE oa.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY nt.id, nt.type_name
ORDER BY 平均在线率 ASC
LIMIT 3;

question: 查询客户DEF集团下，所有路由器类型的设备，列出它们最近30天内的告警总数，以及这些告警中由collector-beijing-01这台采集机发现的比例。
sql:
SELECT 
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名称,
    COUNT(eh.id) AS 总告警数,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cv2.name = 'collector-beijing-01' THEN 1 END) AS 北京采集机发现数,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN cv2.name = 'collector-beijing-01' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(eh.id), 2) AS 占比
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
INNER JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id AND nt.type_name LIKE '%路由器%'
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id AND cust.customer_name = 'DEF集团'
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
LEFT JOIN collector_v2 cv2 ON eh.collector_id = cv2.id
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.ne_name
ORDER BY 总告警数 DESC;

question: 找出那些在最近一个月内，既产生过Critical告警，又产生过Warning告警的设备，列出设备名和所属客户。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名,
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND eh.severity IN ('Critical', 'Warning')
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.ne_name, cust.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT eh.severity) = 2;

question: 统计每个客户在每天的不同时段产生的告警数量，以客户GHI公司最近一周的数据为例。
sql:
SELECT 
    DATE(eh.start_time) AS 日期,
    CASE 
        WHEN HOUR(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-6点'
        WHEN HOUR(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN '6-12点'
        WHEN HOUR(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN '12-18点'
        ELSE '18-24点'
    END AS 时段,
    COUNT(*) AS 告警数量
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE cust.customer_name = 'GHI公司'
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(eh.start_time), 时段
ORDER BY 日期, 时段;

question: 查询所有采集机的健康状态，并关联显示它们所负责的、当前状态为Down的设备列表。
sql:
SELECT 
    cv2.name AS 采集机,
    cv2.health_status AS 采集机健康状态,
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名,
    cust.customer_name AS 所属客户,
    ne.state_change_time AS 设备Down时间

LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv2.id = ne.collector_id AND ne.state = 'Down'

ORDER BY cv2.name, ne.state_change_time DESC;

question: 找出那些告警标题中包含内存或CPU关键词，且在最近3个月内重复发生的告警模式，列出设备、告警标题和发生次数。
sql:
SELECT 
    ne.ne_name AS 设备名,
    eh.title AS 告警标题,
    COUNT(*) AS 发生次数
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
WHERE (eh.title LIKE '%内存%' OR eh.title LIKE '%CPU%')
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.ne_name, eh.title
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY 发生次数 DESC;

question: 统计每个区域下，不同服务包的设备数量分布。
sql:
SELECT 
    reg.region_name AS 区域,
    nsp.service_package_name AS 服务包,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id) AS 设备数量
FROM t_bz_config_region reg
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON reg.id = cust.region_id
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cust.id = ne.customer_id
LEFT JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id AND nsp.service_package_name IN ('基础', '高级', '企业')
GROUP BY reg.id, reg.region_name, nsp.service_package_name
ORDER BY reg.region_name, 设备数量 DESC;

question: 查询某台设备firewall-edge-01的历史告警，找出与它关联性最强的其他设备，列出关联设备名和共同告警次数。
sql:
WITH TargetAlerts AS (
    SELECT start_time, end_time
    FROM event_history
    WHERE ne_id = (SELECT id FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root WHERE ne_name = 'firewall-edge-01')
),
RelatedAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        ne2.ne_name AS 关联设备,
        COUNT(*) AS 共同告警次数
    FROM event_history eh2
    INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne2 ON eh2.ne_id = ne2.id
    INNER JOIN TargetAlerts ta ON eh2.start_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(ta.start_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(ta.end_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
    WHERE ne2.ne_name != 'firewall-edge-01'
    GROUP BY ne2.id, ne2.ne_name
)
SELECT * FROM RelatedAlerts
ORDER BY 共同告警次数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: 列出所有在最近一周内新上线的设备，并检查它们是否已经产生过告警。
sql:
SELECT 
    ne.ne_name AS 新设备名,
    cust.customer_name AS 所属客户,
    ne.create_time AS 上线时间,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(eh.id) > 0 THEN '是'
        ELSE '否'
    END AS 是否已产生告警,
    COUNT(eh.id) AS 告警次数
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= ne.create_time
WHERE ne.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.ne_name, cust.customer_name, ne.create_time
ORDER BY ne.create_time DESC;

question: 对于每个客户，计算其设备在最近30天的MTTR，并列出MTTR最长的前5个客户。
sql:
SELECT 
    cust.customer_name AS 客户名,
    COUNT(eh.id) AS 已恢复告警数,
    ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.end_time)), 2) AS 平均修复时间_分钟
FROM event_history eh
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer cust ON ne.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE eh.end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY cust.id, cust.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(eh.id) > 0
ORDER BY 平均修复时间_分钟 DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 找出在过去一周内，告警总时长排名前5的客户，并显示他们的客户名称、告警总时长以及涉及的主要设备类型。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, COALESCE(eh.end_time, NOW()))) AS total_alarm_hours, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT nt.name) AS main_ne_types FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY total_alarm_hours DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计每个区域在工作日上班时间内产生的严重及以上级别的告警数量，并按告警数量从高到低给出区域排名。
sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS high_severity_alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_region r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.severity >= 3 AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND TIME(eh.start_time) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '18:00:00' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name ORDER BY high_severity_alarm_count DESC;

question: 查询哪些设备在最近一个月内，其关联的所有服务包都至少触发过一次告警，并列出这些设备的名称、IP地址以及它们触发的告警总数。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, ne.ip_address, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS total_alarms FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.ne_id = nsp.ne_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND ne.ne_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT nsp1.ne_id FROM ne_service_package nsp1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ne_service_package nsp2 LEFT JOIN event_history eh2 ON nsp2.ne_id = eh2.ne_id AND eh2.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) WHERE nsp2.ne_id = nsp1.ne_id AND nsp2.service_package_id = nsp1.service_package_id AND eh2.event_id IS NULL ) ) GROUP BY ne.ne_id, ne.ne_name, ne.ip_address;

question: 找出告警平均恢复时间最长的前3种设备类型，要求统计过去三个月内所有已恢复的告警。
sql: SELECT nt.name AS device_type, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.end_time)) AS avg_mttr_minutes FROM ne_type nt JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON nt.ne_type_id = ne.ne_type_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.end_time IS NOT NULL AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY nt.ne_type_id, nt.name ORDER BY avg_mttr_minutes DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 查询在最近一周内，连续告警持续时间超过24小时且仍未恢复的设备TOP10，并显示设备名、客户名、告警开始时间和当前持续时间。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, c.customer_name, eh.start_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, NOW()) AS ongoing_duration_hours FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.end_time IS NULL AND eh.start_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY ongoing_duration_hours DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计每个采集机所负责监控的设备中，在过去24小时内产生告警的设备比例，并按照比例从高到低排名，仅显示比例大于0的采集机。
sql: SELECT cv2.collector_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eh.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN ne.ne_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) AS alarm_device_ratio FROM collector_v2 cv2 LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv2.collector_id = ne.collector_id LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY cv2.collector_id, cv2.collector_name HAVING alarm_device_ratio > 0 ORDER BY alarm_device_ratio DESC;

question: 找出那些在最近一个月内，其负责的客户产生的告警总数超过该客户历史平均月告警数2倍以上的联系人，列出联系人姓名、所属客户及本月告警数。
sql: SELECT ct.contact_name, c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS current_month_alarms FROM t_bz_config_contact ct JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND c.customer_id IN ( SELECT c_inner.customer_id FROM t_bz_config_customer c_inner JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne_inner ON c_inner.customer_id = ne_inner.customer_id JOIN event_history eh_inner ON ne_inner.ne_id = eh_inner.ne_id GROUP BY c_inner.customer_id HAVING COUNT(eh_inner.event_id) / TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, MIN(eh_inner.start_time), NOW()) * 2 < COUNT(CASE WHEN eh_inner.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) THEN 1 END) ) GROUP BY ct.contact_id, ct.contact_name, c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

question: 查询在最近一个完整季度内，每个工作日上午9点到11点这个时间段内，告警频率最高的前5个设备。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) / (COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(eh.start_time)) * 2) AS avg_alarms_per_hour FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE QUARTER(eh.start_time) = QUARTER(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND TIME(eh.start_time) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '11:00:00' GROUP BY ne.ne_id, ne.ne_name ORDER BY avg_alarms_per_hour DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 找出那些状态为在线，但其所属采集机健康状态为异常或离线的所有设备，并列出设备名、IP、采集机名及采集机状态。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, ne.ip_address, cv2.collector_name, cv2.health_status FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN collector_v2 cv2 ON ne.collector_id = cv2.collector_id WHERE ne.status = '在线' AND cv2.health_status IN ('异常', '离线');

question: 统计每个区域下，不同类型设备的告警总数，并给出每个区域内告警数最多的设备类型排名。
sql: SELECT r.region_name, nt.name AS top_alarm_device_type, alarm_count FROM ( SELECT c.region_id, ne.ne_type_id, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region_id ORDER BY COUNT(eh.event_id) DESC) AS rnk FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id GROUP BY c.region_id, ne.ne_type_id ) ranked JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON ranked.region_id = r.region_id JOIN ne_type nt ON ranked.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id WHERE ranked.rnk = 1;

question: 查询在过去72小时内，产生了超过3种不同告警类型的设备，列出设备名、客户名以及具体的告警类型列表。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, c.customer_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT et.name) AS alarm_types FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id JOIN event_type et ON eh.event_type_id = et.event_type_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) GROUP BY ne.ne_id, ne.ne_name, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT eh.event_type_id) > 3;

question: 找出那些在最近一个月内没有任何告警，但其关联的服务包数量却大于等于3个的设备，列出设备名和其服务包数量。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, COUNT(nsp.service_package_id) AS service_package_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.ne_id = nsp.ne_id WHERE ne.ne_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ne_id FROM event_history WHERE start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) GROUP BY ne.ne_id, ne.ne_name HAVING COUNT(nsp.service_package_id) >= 3;

question: 统计每个客户在最近一年内，每月告警数量的变化趋势，并找出那些连续三个月告警数量环比增长的客户。
sql: WITH monthly_alarms AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, DATE_FORMAT(eh.start_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, DATE_FORMAT(eh.start_time, '%Y-%m') ), growth AS ( SELECT customer_id, customer_name, month, alarm_count, LAG(alarm_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_count FROM monthly_alarms ) SELECT DISTINCT customer_name FROM growth WHERE alarm_count > prev_month_count AND prev_month_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND MIN(month) <= DATE_SUB(MAX(month), INTERVAL 2 MONTH);

question: 查询在最近一周内，同一设备在1小时内重复触发相同告警类型超过5次的案例，列出设备名、告警类型和重复次数。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, et.name AS alarm_type, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS repeat_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id JOIN event_type et ON eh.event_type_id = et.event_type_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY ne.ne_id, ne.ne_name, eh.event_type_id, et.name, DATE(eh.start_time), HOUR(eh.start_time) HAVING COUNT(eh.event_id) > 5;

question: 找出那些负责设备数量排名前10%的采集机，并计算这些采集机所负责设备的平均告警率。
sql: WITH collector_device_count AS ( SELECT cv2.collector_id, cv2.collector_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) AS device_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) DESC) AS rnk, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_collectors FROM collector_v2 cv2 LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv2.collector_id = ne.collector_id GROUP BY cv2.collector_id, cv2.collector_name ), top_collectors AS ( SELECT collector_id, collector_name FROM collector_device_count WHERE rnk <= CEIL(total_collectors * 0.1) ) SELECT tc.collector_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) AS avg_alarm_rate FROM top_collectors tc LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON tc.collector_id = ne.collector_id LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id GROUP BY tc.collector_id, tc.collector_name;

question: 统计每个设备类型下，告警持续时间超过该类型平均告警持续时间2倍以上的设备数量。
sql: WITH type_avg_duration AS ( SELECT nt.ne_type_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.end_time)) AS avg_duration FROM ne_type nt JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON nt.ne_type_id = ne.ne_type_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY nt.ne_type_id ) SELECT nt.name AS device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) AS exceed_count FROM ne_type nt JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON nt.ne_type_id = ne.ne_type_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id JOIN type_avg_duration tad ON nt.ne_type_id = tad.ne_type_id WHERE eh.end_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.end_time) > tad.avg_duration * 2 GROUP BY nt.ne_type_id, nt.name;

question: 查询在最近一个月内，既有割接订单又有售后工单的客户，并列出这些客户名以及他们各自的工单数量。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS cutover_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT ao.order_id) AS aft_orders FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN atomic_cutover_order co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id AND co.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) LEFT JOIN atomic_aft_order ao ON c.customer_id = ao.customer_id AND ao.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ao.order_id) > 0;

question: 找出在最近一周内，告警数量突然激增的日期和设备类型组合。
sql: WITH daily_alarms AS ( SELECT DATE(eh.start_time) AS alarm_date, nt.ne_type_id, nt.name AS device_type, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS alarm_count FROM event_history eh JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.ne_id JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.ne_type_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(eh.start_time), nt.ne_type_id, nt.name ) SELECT da1.alarm_date, da1.device_type, da1.alarm_count AS current_day, da2.alarm_count AS previous_day FROM daily_alarms da1 LEFT JOIN daily_alarms da2 ON da1.ne_type_id = da2.ne_type_id AND da1.alarm_date = DATE_ADD(da2.alarm_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE da1.alarm_count > da2.alarm_count * 3 AND da1.alarm_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

question: 查询那些联系人负责的客户所产生的告警，在过去一个月内被自动确认的比例低于50%的联系人，列出其姓名和自动确认率。
sql: SELECT ct.contact_name, SUM(CASE WHEN eh.auto_ack = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(eh.event_id) AS auto_ack_rate FROM t_bz_config_contact ct JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY ct.contact_id, ct.contact_name HAVING auto_ack_rate < 50;

question: 统计每个区域在工作时间内和非工作时间产生的告警严重程度的平均值，并找出那些工作时间平均严重程度反而更高的区域。
sql: SELECT r.region_name, AVG(CASE WHEN TIME(eh.start_time) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '18:00:00' THEN eh.severity END) AS avg_severity_work_hours, AVG(CASE WHEN TIME(eh.start_time) NOT BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '18:00:00' THEN eh.severity END) AS avg_severity_non_work_hours FROM t_bz_config_region r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name HAVING avg_severity_work_hours > avg_severity_non_work_hours;

question: 找出在最近三个月内，从未触发过任何告警，但其所属采集机上其他设备告警总数却排名前10的采集机上的这些安静设备。
sql: WITH top_collectors AS ( SELECT cv2.collector_id, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS total_alarms FROM collector_v2 cv2 JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv2.collector_id = ne.collector_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY cv2.collector_id ORDER BY total_alarms DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ne.ne_name, ne.ip_address, cv2.collector_name FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN collector_v2 cv2 ON ne.collector_id = cv2.collector_id JOIN top_collectors tc ON cv2.collector_id = tc.collector_id WHERE ne.ne_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ne_id FROM event_history WHERE start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) );

question: 查询每个客户下，告警恢复时间最长的前3条告警记录，列出客户名、设备名、告警开始时间、恢复时间和持续时间。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ne.ne_name, eh.start_time, eh.end_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.end_time) AS duration_minutes FROM ( SELECT ne.customer_id, eh.ne_id, eh.start_time, eh.end_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ne.customer_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.end_time) DESC) AS rnk FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.end_time IS NOT NULL ) ranked JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ranked.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON ranked.ne_id = ne.ne_id WHERE ranked.rnk <= 3 ORDER BY c.customer_name, ranked.rnk;

question: 统计过去一年中，每个月新增的设备数量，并与当月这些新设备产生的告警数量进行关联对比，列出月份、新增设备数、告警数。
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ne.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) AS new_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT eh.event_id) AS alarms_from_new_devices FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id AND DATE_FORMAT(eh.start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(ne.create_time, '%Y-%m') WHERE ne.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ne.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;

question: 找出那些在最近一周内，每天都有告警产生，且每天告警数量都超过5条的设备，列出设备名和其一周总告警数。
sql: SELECT ne.ne_name, COUNT(eh.event_id) AS weekly_alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY ne.ne_id, ne.ne_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(eh.start_time)) = 7 AND MIN( CASE WHEN DATE(eh.start_time) = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_history eh2 WHERE eh2.ne_id = ne.ne_id AND DATE(eh2.start_time) = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) END ) > 5;

question: 查询每个服务包所关联的设备中，在过去一个月内产生告警的设备占比，并按照占比从高到低排序，仅显示关联设备数大于10的服务包。
sql: SELECT sp.service_package_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eh.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN ne.ne_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) AS alarmed_device_percentage FROM ne_service_package sp JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON sp.ne_id = ne.ne_id LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY sp.service_package_id, sp.service_package_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ne.ne_id) > 10 ORDER BY alarmed_device_percentage DESC;

question: 找出在最近一个季度内，其负责客户的总告警数排名前5的联系人，但同时这些联系人负责的客户中，有超过30%的客户在过去一个月内没有新告警。
sql: WITH contact_alarm_stats AS ( SELECT ct.contact_id, ct.contact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT eh.event_id) AS total_alarms_last_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne2 JOIN event_history eh2 ON ne2.ne_id = eh2.ne_id WHERE ne2.customer_id = c.customer_id AND eh2.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) THEN c.customer_id END) AS customers_no_recent_alarm FROM t_bz_config_contact ct JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.customer_id = ne.customer_id JOIN event_history eh ON ne.ne_id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY ct.contact_id, ct.contact_name ) SELECT contact_name, total_alarms_last_quarter, customers_no_recent_alarm * 100.0 / total_customers AS inactive_customer_percentage FROM contact_alarm_stats WHERE customers_no_recent_alarm * 100.0 / total_customers > 30 ORDER BY total_alarms_last_quarter DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计过去一个月内，每个客户在工作日上班时间发生的严重及以上级别告警的平均持续时间，并给出平均持续时间最长的前5个客户。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, eh.start_time, eh.end_time)) AS avg_duration_seconds
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
WHERE eh.severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'MAJOR')
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6
  AND HOUR(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND eh.end_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY avg_duration_seconds DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 找出最近一周内，告警总数排名前三的设备类型，并且这些告警必须发生在采集机状态为ACTIVE的设备上。
sql:
SELECT nt.name AS device_type, COUNT(eh.id) AS alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
JOIN collector_v2 cv ON ne.collector_id = cv.id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND cv.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY nt.id, nt.name
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: 查询某个指定区域下，所有客户在过去一个季度内，由路由器和交换机类型设备产生的、且持续时间超过1小时的告警事件总数，并按客户告警数降序排列。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(eh.id) AS long_alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON c.region_id = r.id
WHERE r.region_name = '华东'
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  AND nt.name IN ('路由器', '交换机')
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, eh.end_time) > 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY long_alarm_count DESC;

question: 找出所有服务包中包含性能监控项的设备，并统计这些设备在上个月每个工作日产生的告警数量，列出设备名和对应的每日告警数。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, DATE(eh.start_time) AS alarm_date, COUNT(eh.id) AS daily_alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id
JOIN ne_service_item nsi ON nsp.id = nsi.service_package_id
WHERE nsi.service_item_name LIKE '%性能监控%'
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, DATE(eh.start_time)
ORDER BY ne.device_name, alarm_date;

question: 统计每个采集机所管理的设备中，在过去72小时内发生过告警且告警级别为严重的设备数量，并列出管理此类设备数量最多的前3个采集机及其IP地址。
sql:
SELECT cv.name AS collector_name, cv.ip_address, COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id) AS critical_device_count
FROM collector_v2 cv
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv.id = ne.collector_id

question: 查询某位特定联系人所负责的所有客户，其名下设备在过去一周内产生的、尚未恢复的告警列表，并按照告警开始时间倒序排列。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, ne.device_name, eh.alarm_type, eh.start_time, eh.severity
FROM t_bz_config_contact ct
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ct.customer_id = c.id
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.id = ne.customer_id
JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id
WHERE ct.contact_name = '张三' -- 替换为具体联系人姓名
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND eh.end_time IS NULL
ORDER BY eh.start_time DESC;

question: 找出过去一个月内，平均告警响应时间最慢的5个客户。响应时间只计算在工作时间内产生的告警。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.ack_time)) AS avg_response_minutes
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND HOUR(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND eh.ack_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY avg_response_minutes DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 统计每个区域下，不同类型设备在最近30天内发生的网络连通性相关告警的次数，并给出每个区域下告警数最多的设备类型。
sql:
WITH RegionAlarm AS (
    SELECT r.region_name, nt.name AS device_type, COUNT(eh.id) AS alarm_count
    FROM event_history eh
    JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
    JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON c.region_id = r.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
      AND (eh.alarm_type LIKE '%ping%' OR eh.alarm_type LIKE '%connect%')
    GROUP BY r.id, r.region_name, nt.id, nt.name
)
SELECT ra.region_name, ra.device_type, ra.alarm_count
FROM RegionAlarm ra
JOIN (
    SELECT region_name, MAX(alarm_count) AS max_count
    FROM RegionAlarm
    GROUP BY region_name
) max_ra ON ra.region_name = max_ra.region_name AND ra.alarm_count = max_ra.max_count
ORDER BY ra.region_name;

question: 查询所有状态为在线的设备，找出那些在最近一周内，其关联的服务包中采集失败次数超过3次的设备，并列出设备名和所属客户。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, c.customer_name, COUNT(nch.id) AS collect_fail_count
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id
JOIN ne_collect_history nch ON nsp.id = nch.service_package_id
WHERE ne.status = '在线'
  AND nch.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND nch.status = 'FAILED'
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, c.customer_name
HAVING collect_fail_count > 3
ORDER BY collect_fail_count DESC;

question: 找出在过去24小时内，产生告警频率最高的前10台设备，并同时显示这些设备所属的客户名称和负责的联系人电话。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, c.customer_name, ct.phone, COUNT(eh.id) AS alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_contact ct ON c.id = ct.customer_id AND ct.is_primary = 1
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, c.customer_name, ct.phone
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: 统计每个客户在最近一个完整自然月内，其所有设备在核心业务时段发生的严重级别告警的总时长，并按总时长从高到低排序。
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name,
       SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,
           GREATEST(eh.start_time, DATE_ADD(DATE(eh.start_time), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)),
           LEAST(COALESCE(eh.end_time, NOW()), DATE_ADD(DATE(eh.start_time), INTERVAL 20 HOUR))
       )) AS total_critical_hours
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
WHERE eh.severity = 'CRITICAL'
  AND eh.start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND (eh.end_time IS NULL OR eh.end_time >= DATE_ADD(DATE(eh.start_time), INTERVAL 8 HOUR))
  AND eh.start_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(eh.start_time), INTERVAL 20 HOUR)
GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_critical_hours DESC;

question: 查询哪些采集机管理的设备中，超过50%的设备在过去一周内都至少产生过一次告警。列出这些采集机名称及其管理的设备总数和告警设备数。
sql:
WITH DeviceAlarm AS (
    SELECT ne.collector_id, ne.id AS device_id,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(eh.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_alarm
    FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
    LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    GROUP BY ne.collector_id, ne.id
),
CollectorStats AS (
    SELECT cv.id, cv.name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS total_devices,
           SUM(da.has_alarm) AS alarm_devices
    FROM collector_v2 cv
    LEFT JOIN DeviceAlarm da ON cv.id = da.collector_id
    GROUP BY cv.id, cv.name
)
SELECT name, total_devices, alarm_devices
FROM CollectorStats
WHERE total_devices > 0 AND (alarm_devices * 1.0 / total_devices) > 0.5
ORDER BY (alarm_devices * 1.0 / total_devices) DESC;

question: 找出最近3个月内，从未发生过任何告警的在线状态设备，并显示这些设备所属的客户及设备类型。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, c.customer_name, nt.name AS device_type
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
WHERE ne.status = '在线'
  AND ne.id NOT IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT eh.ne_id
      FROM event_history eh
      WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  )
ORDER BY c.customer_name, ne.device_name;

question: 统计每个服务包在最近30天内，其绑定的设备在非工作时间产生的告警数量，并列出告警数最多的前5个服务包名称。
sql:
SELECT nsp.name AS service_package_name, COUNT(eh.id) AS off_hour_alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND (
      (DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND (HOUR(eh.start_time) < 9 OR HOUR(eh.start_time) >= 18))
      OR
      (DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) IN (1, 7))
  )
GROUP BY nsp.id, nsp.name
ORDER BY off_hour_alarm_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 查询某大型客户名下，所有路由器设备在过去一周内，连续两次告警间隔小于10分钟的频繁告警序列。列出设备名、告警时间及告警类型。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, eh1.start_time AS alarm_time_1, eh1.alarm_type AS type_1,
       eh2.start_time AS alarm_time_2, eh2.alarm_type AS type_2
FROM event_history eh1
JOIN event_history eh2 ON eh1.ne_id = eh2.ne_id
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh1.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
WHERE ne.customer_id = 1001
  AND nt.name = '路由器'
  AND eh1.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND eh2.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND eh2.start_time > eh1.start_time
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh1.start_time, eh2.start_time) < 10
ORDER BY ne.device_name, eh1.start_time;

question: 找出那些管理着超过100台设备，且这些设备在上个月的平均每日可用性低于99.9%的采集机。列出采集机名和设备平均可用性。
sql:
SELECT cv.name AS collector_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ne.id) AS device_count,
       AVG(da.availability_percentage) AS avg_availability
FROM collector_v2 cv
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cv.id = ne.collector_id
JOIN day_availability da ON ne.id = da.ne_id
WHERE da.stat_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND da.stat_date < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
GROUP BY cv.id, cv.name
HAVING device_count > 100 AND avg_availability < 99.9
ORDER BY avg_availability ASC;

question: 统计过去一年中，每个季度内，由不同设备类型产生的重大级别以上告警的数量变化趋势。输出季度、设备类型和告警数。
sql:
SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(eh.start_time), '-Q', QUARTER(eh.start_time)) AS quarter,
       nt.name AS device_type,
       COUNT(eh.id) AS major_alarm_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN ne_type nt ON ne.ne_type_id = nt.id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
  AND eh.severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'MAJOR')
GROUP BY YEAR(eh.start_time), QUARTER(eh.start_time), nt.id, nt.name
ORDER BY quarter, device_type;

question: 查询所有在最近一周内有过硬件变更记录的设备，并检查这些设备在变更后是否产生了新的告警。列出设备名、变更时间及变更后告警数量。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, h.update_time AS hardware_change_time,
       COUNT(eh.id) AS post_change_alarms
FROM hardware h
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON h.ne_id = ne.id
LEFT JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time > h.update_time
WHERE h.update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, h.update_time
ORDER BY post_change_alarms DESC;

question: 找出那些在过去一个月内，其负责的客户产生的告警总数超过该客户历史月平均告警数2倍的联系人。列出联系人姓名、客户名及本月告警数与月平均数的比值。
sql:
WITH MonthlyAvg AS (
    SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
           AVG(monthly_count) AS avg_monthly_alarms
    FROM (
        SELECT ne.customer_id,
               DATE_FORMAT(eh.start_time, '%Y-%m') AS month,
               COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
        FROM event_history eh
        JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
        GROUP BY ne.customer_id, DATE_FORMAT(eh.start_time, '%Y-%m')
    ) hist
    JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON hist.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id
),
CurrentMonth AS (
    SELECT ne.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS current_month_alarms
    FROM event_history eh
    JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')
      AND eh.start_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
    GROUP BY ne.customer_id
)
SELECT ct.contact_name, c.customer_name,
       cm.current_month_alarms,
       ma.avg_monthly_alarms,
       cm.current_month_alarms / ma.avg_monthly_alarms AS ratio
FROM t_bz_config_contact ct
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ct.customer_id = c.id
JOIN CurrentMonth cm ON c.id = cm.customer_id
JOIN MonthlyAvg ma ON c.id = ma.customer_id
WHERE cm.current_month_alarms > ma.avg_monthly_alarms * 2
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

question: 统计每个区域在最近90天内，工作日与非工作日产生的告警总数对比。输出区域名称、工作日告警数、非工作日告警数及两者差值。
sql:
SELECT r.region_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_alarms,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_alarms,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(eh.start_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS difference
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON c.region_id = r.id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
GROUP BY r.id, r.region_name
ORDER BY ABS(difference) DESC;

question: 查询那些绑定了超过3个不同服务包的设备，并计算这些设备在过去一周内，每个服务包对应的平均告警响应时间，列出设备名和每个服务包的平均响应时间。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, nsp.name AS service_package_name,
       AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.start_time, eh.ack_time)) AS avg_response_minutes
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
JOIN ne_service_package nsp ON ne.id = nsp.ne_id
JOIN event_history eh ON ne.id = eh.ne_id AND eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND eh.ack_time IS NOT NULL
WHERE ne.id IN (
    SELECT ne_id
    FROM ne_service_package
    GROUP BY ne_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 3
)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, nsp.id, nsp.name
ORDER BY ne.device_name, avg_response_minutes DESC;

question: 找出在最近48小时内，同一台设备上重复出现超过5次的告警模式。列出设备名、告警类型及重复次数。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, eh.alarm_type, COUNT(*) AS repeat_count
FROM event_history eh
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, eh.alarm_type
HAVING repeat_count > 5
ORDER BY repeat_count DESC;

question: 统计每个客户等级在最近一个月内，其设备因电源或风扇故障导致的告警总时长，并计算此类告警占总告警时长的百分比。
sql:
WITH TotalAlarmTime AS (
    SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.level,
           SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, COALESCE(eh.end_time, NOW()))) AS total_hours
    FROM event_history eh
    JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
    GROUP BY c.id, c.level
),
PowerFanAlarmTime AS (
    SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
           SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, eh.start_time, COALESCE(eh.end_time, NOW()))) AS power_fan_hours
    FROM event_history eh
    JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ne_id = ne.id
    JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE eh.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
      AND (eh.alarm_type LIKE '%电源%' OR eh.alarm_type LIKE '%风扇%')
    GROUP BY c.id
)
SELECT tat.level,
       SUM(COALESCE(pfat.power_fan_hours, 0)) AS total_power_fan_hours,
       SUM(tat.total_hours) AS total_all_hours,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(pfat.power_fan_hours, 0)) * 100.0 / SUM(tat.total_hours), 2) AS percentage
FROM TotalAlarmTime tat
LEFT JOIN PowerFanAlarmTime pfat ON tat.customer_id = pfat.customer_id
GROUP BY tat.level
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

question: 查询所有核心区域的设备，找出那些在最近一周内，其采集任务成功率低于95%的设备，并列出设备名、所属客户及采集成功率。
sql:
SELECT ne.device_name, c.customer_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN nch.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(nch.id) AS success_rate
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.customer_id = c.id
JOIN t_bz_config_region r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN ne_collect_history nch ON ne.id = nch.ne_id
WHERE r.region_name LIKE '%核心%'
  AND nch.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY ne.id, ne.device_name, c.customer_name
HAVING success_rate < 95
ORDER BY success_rate ASC;

question: 找出在过去30天内，产生告警的设备数量最多的前3个服务包，并列出这些服务包所覆盖的客户数量。
sql:
